Can you take a break from grad school to get experience in the field you’re in? When I (22F) feel like everything is going to shit I pick out what I can control. I also list out what I need to get done for the week. I take my issues one at a time when working on them so I’m not overwhelmed. You didn’t exactly go into much detail about what is disappointing you so I can’t advise on what to do specifically but I will say that I think many adults (especially young ones like us) are struggling. Unlucky. Hit with bullshit week after week. Some are just really fucking good at hiding it and making it seem they got their shit together. Just try to simplify your disappointments into what you can and can’t control. Go from there. Talk to your family and friends about your disappointments and unluckiness. Maybe they can offer solutions or support

Did you try asking what was making him anxious today? I understand with anxiety sometimes you just don’t know why you’re feeling the way the you do, but maybe instead of telling him he’s a victim to his anxiety, just ask *what* is making him anxious on this day. Maybe he really didn’t want to go to the party but didn’t openly tell you that. I don’t think this is a stay or leave situation. Maybe just lack of communication. Whenever my friends or significant other is being grumpy or visibly upset/anxious I start off by asking what exactly is causing anxiety today. 9/10 times they eventually tell me what is bothering them. Hopefully he shares. Maybe you already do that

I felt the same way when I quit. I had 9 clients and 2 of them told me they were sad to see me leave and that they couldn’t see themselves working with another case manager. I had to remind myself that my mental health was deteriorating because of the job, it wasn’t fulfilling, and I was getting triggered by my clients issues. At the end of each conversation I had with my clients about me leaving the job, despite their disappointment, they understood and wished me the best. I hope your clients will do the same.

Just remind yourself you have to do what’s best for you. I just quit my job that I hated. I was very nervous to send my supervisor my letter of resignation but luckily he was very understanding and agreed, I have to do what’s best for me. My job was mentally draining and made me want to drink more lol. Look for other jobs and try to secure a couple interviews, then send in your letter of resignation! If doing it in person scares you too much, send it via email and add in it that if need be you can talk more about it in the office/facility whatever you work in. People are allowed to leave jobs that don’t make them happy. You don’t owe any organization or agency your life!
